intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and breathtaking 360-degree sunset views over the atolls. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, manta rays, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to three of the most pristine and biodiverse reef spots in the atolls, with equipment provided and a marine biologist on board to narrate the underwater world.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two
experiences.description: Dine in an extraordinary all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living reef. Enjoy a curated five-course fine-dining menu featuring fresh Maldivian lobster, tuna sashimi, and locally inspired desserts while watching reef fish glide past your table — an unforgettable honeymoon dining experience.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, Alif Dhaal Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit a traditional fishing village on a local island to experience authentic Maldivian culture. Explore mosques, craft workshops, and local markets before joining a hands-on cooking class where you learn to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa snacks using fresh local ingredients.

experiences.name: Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Retreat
experiences.description: Indulge in a luxurious two-hour couples spa treatment in an overwater pavilion with direct ocean views. The package includes a traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage, a flower petal bath drawn over the lagoon, and a private relaxation deck where you can sip herbal teas and watch the crystal-clear water below — the ultimate honeymoon luxury.
experiences.location: Baa Atoll, UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, Maldives

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and arrange speedboat or ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink at the resort. Take a short stroll along the beachfront to soak in the night ambiance of the island.

meals.breakfast: On the flight
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport
meals.dinner: Light snack or welcome bites provided at resort check-in; grab a budget-friendly bite at the resort's casual bar if available

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange your speedboat or public ferry transfer in advance to save costs. Keep essentials like a change of clothes and toiletries in your carry-on for a smooth late-night arrival. Exchange a small amount of USD before leaving the airport.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. After a leisurely wake-up, enjoy breakfast at the resort. Take a relaxed morning walk along the beachfront to get oriented with the island, watch the sunrise over the Indian Ocean, and dip your toes in the crystal-clear lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's house reef for your first snorkeling session. Rent basic snorkeling gear from the resort if you haven't brought your own (budget tip: bring your own mask and fins to save rental fees). Explore the colorful coral gardens and spot tropical fish, sea turtles, and reef sharks in the shallow lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset from the beach with a local fresh coconut drink. Explore the island on foot and find a budget-friendly local eatery or the resort's more casual dining option for dinner. Enjoy a romantic beachside stroll under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet (included if part of package) or order à la carte eggs, toast, and fresh tropical fruit
meals.lunch: Pack a light picnic from a local shop — fresh fruit, crackers, and juice — or grab a casual meal at the resort's beach grill
meals.dinner: Dine at a local guesthouse restaurant or the resort's casual dining area; try fresh grilled fish with rice and salad (~$10–$18 per person)

day_by_day.notes: March weather in Maldives is typically sunny with calm seas — ideal for snorkeling. Apply reef-safe sunscreen generously. Stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling at the house reef during the golden hour — the best time to spot marine life when the water is calmest and visibility is highest. Look out for manta rays, parrotfish, and clownfish among the anemones.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a shared group snorkeling excursion to a nearby coral reef or sandbank (book through a local dive school or guesthouse operator for budget rates, typically $25–$40 per person). Visit a famous snorkeling spot like a nearby uninhabited island reef.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a couple's sunset yoga session on the beach (many resorts offer complimentary or low-cost sessions). Relax with herbal tea and watch the sky turn pink and orange over the lagoon.

meals.breakfast: Fresh tropical fruit platter, yogurt, and local roshi bread with honey at the resort or a nearby café
meals.lunch: Pack a light lunch from a local shop to eat on the excursion boat or sandbank — tuna sandwiches and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Romantic candlelit dinner at the resort's beach restaurant; opt for the set menu or daily special for better value (~$20–$30 for two)

day_by_day.notes: Book group excursions rather than private charters to save significantly. Always confirm if snorkeling equipment is included in the excursion price.

day_by_day.morning: Visit the local island market (if on or near a local island) to browse fresh produce, handmade crafts, and souvenirs. Chat with locals and learn about Maldivian culture and daily island life. Pick up affordable handcrafted keepsakes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the island's natural beauty with a guided nature walk or self-guided cycling tour around the island perimeter. Stop at scenic viewpoints, lush vegetation patches, and hidden coves. Relax on a secluded stretch of beach for a private romantic moment.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a DIY romantic beach picnic at sunset — pick up fresh bread, local tuna (mas), tropical fruits, and juice from a local shop. Lay out a sarong on the beach and watch the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Local Maldivian breakfast — mas huni (tuna and coconut salad) with roshi flatbread and black tea at a local teahouse (~$3–$5)
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood rice bowl or short eats (hedhikaa) at a local café (~$5–$8)
meals.dinner: DIY romantic picnic on the beach with local groceries; budget ~$10–$15 for two

day_by_day.notes: Local teahouses (called 'sai hotels') offer incredibly cheap and authentic Maldivian food. This is one of the best budget-friendly dining experiences available.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling session focusing on a specific marine life goal — try to find and photograph sea turtles at a known turtle cleaning station near the house reef. Spend 1–2 hours calmly observing marine life without disturbing the ecosystem.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a budget-friendly dolphin watching cruise (shared boat, ~$20–$30 per person) in the late afternoon. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in the Maldives during March. Enjoy the open ocean breeze and dramatic ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Return from the cruise at dusk. Relax at the resort with a refreshing mocktail or local iced drink. Share photos from the day and enjoy a quiet, intimate evening together on the beachfront.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl with tropical fruits, granola, and coconut milk at the resort café
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's beach grill — grilled fish tacos or a fresh salad (~$10–$15)
meals.dinner: Try a local restaurant's fresh catch of the day — grilled snapper or tuna steak with steamed rice and coconut curry (~$12–$18 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin watching is best in the late afternoon when pods come closer to shore. Bring a light jacket for the boat ride as it can get breezy on the open water.

day_by_day.morning: Spend a leisurely morning at the resort's beachfront. Practice snorkeling techniques, float in the crystal-clear lagoon, or simply relax on sun loungers with a good book. Enjoy the peaceful morning before the day heats up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a shared sandbank excursion to a nearby uninhabited sandbank (locally called a 'finolhu'). Spend the afternoon swimming, sunbathing, and snorkeling in the pristine turquoise waters around the sandbank — a quintessential Maldivian experience.
day_by_day.evening: Back at the resort, treat yourselves to a budget-friendly couples' spa treatment — opt for a single shared massage session or a foot reflexology treatment (~$30–$50) to keep costs manageable while still indulging in some luxury.

meals.breakfast: Continental breakfast at the resort — croissants, jam, cheese, fresh juice, and coffee
meals.lunch: Pack snacks and water for the sandbank trip; enjoy fresh coconut water served on the sandbank if available
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly for a special dinner — a romantic beachside dinner under the stars at the resort's signature restaurant; choose a set menu (~$25–$35 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank excursion is a must-do in the Maldives. Book through local operators for better rates than resort-offered excursions. Bring waterproof sunscreen, a hat, and plenty of water.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip rest day. Sleep in, enjoy a slow breakfast, and spend the morning journaling, reading, or simply sitting at the water's edge. Reflect on the trip so far and plan any remaining activities or excursions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore local island culture by visiting a nearby inhabited local island via public ferry (very affordable, often under $5 one way). Walk through the island, visit the local mosque, and observe everyday Maldivian life respectfully.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort before sunset. Enjoy a romantic evening walk along the beach collecting shells. Watch the bioluminescent plankton light up the shoreline after dark — a magical natural phenomenon common in the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — eggs any style, fresh tropical fruits, pastries, and coffee or tea
meals.lunch: Eat at a local teahouse on the inhabited island — short eats, curry, and tea for under $5 per person
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort or a nearby local restaurant; try garudhiya (fish broth soup) with rice, lime, and chili (~$8–$12)

day_by_day.notes: When visiting local inhabited islands, dress modestly — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local Islamic customs. Bioluminescent plankton sightings are more common on darker, moonless nights — check the lunar calendar.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) session on the calm lagoon. Many resorts offer complimentary or low-cost access to non-motorized water sports equipment. Paddle around the island for stunning views of the resort and lagoon from the water.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling expedition to a new reef location — ask the resort or a local dive shop to recommend a lesser-known reef with excellent marine biodiversity. Spend 2–3 hours exploring and photographing the underwater world.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktail hour on the beach (opt for mocktails or local fruit drinks to save money). Dress up slightly and take romantic photos together on the beach as the sky turns golden — create lasting honeymoon memories.

meals.breakfast: Açaí bowl or fresh fruit salad with granola and coconut yogurt at the resort café
meals.lunch: Fresh tuna salad sandwich or local short eats at a beachside shack (~$5–$8)
meals.dinner: Barbecue night at the resort if available — fresh seafood BBQ on the beach is a great value and experience; or find a local BBQ spot (~$15–$20 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Check if the resort offers complimentary non-motorized water sports — many guesthouses and mid-range resorts in the Maldives include kayaks and SUPs at no extra cost.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning glass-bottom boat tour to observe coral reefs and marine life without getting wet — a great option if you want a change of pace from snorkeling. These shared tours are typically affordable (~$15–$25 per person) and very scenic.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax at the resort's beachfront. Build sandcastles, swim in the lagoon, or simply lounge under a palm tree with a cold drink. Enjoy the simple pleasures of island life without any agenda.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private romantic beach setup through the resort — many budget-friendly resorts offer a simple candlelit beach dinner setup for an additional fee (~$30–$50 setup fee). Dine under the stars with the sound of the ocean waves.

meals.breakfast: Maldivian-style breakfast — roshi, mas huni, and black tea at a local café to keep costs down
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort — fresh fruit smoothie, a sandwich, and salad (~$10–$12)
meals.dinner: Special candlelit beach dinner — pre-order a set menu with the resort to keep costs predictable; fresh seafood, rice, and dessert (~$40–$60 for two as a special treat)

day_by_day.notes: The private beach dinner is a worthwhile splurge for a honeymoon/romance trip. Negotiate with the resort in advance and ask if they can offer a package deal to reduce costs.

day_by_day.morning: Final dedicated snorkeling morning — revisit your favorite reef spot or try a new one recommended by resort staff. Focus on underwater photography using a waterproof camera or phone case to capture memories of the incredible marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local island's souvenir shops to purchase meaningful keepsakes — lacquerwork (laajehun), woven mats, and miniature dhoni boats are traditional Maldivian crafts. Practice gentle bargaining for better prices.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Bodu Beru (big drum) cultural performance if available on the island or at the resort. This traditional Maldivian music and dance performance is a wonderful cultural experience and often free or very low cost.

meals.breakfast: Tropical fruit platter with fresh papaya, mango, and pineapple, plus scrambled eggs and toast at the resort
meals.lunch: Local teahouse lunch on the nearby island — fish curry, rice, and a cold drink (~$5–$7 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort or local restaurant; try mas riha (Maldivian fish curry) with steamed rice and papadum (~$10–$15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Bodu Beru performances are typically held in the evenings and are a highlight of Maldivian culture. Ask the resort or local guesthouse about upcoming performances during your stay.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise meditation or yoga session on the beach — find a quiet spot away from the resort's busy areas and practice mindfulness as the sun rises over the Indian Ocean. A peaceful and free way to start the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a leisurely dhoni boat ride (traditional Maldivian wooden boat) around the lagoon. Many local operators offer affordable shared rides that give you a unique perspective of the island and surrounding waters. Keep an eye out for sea turtles and reef sharks from the boat.
day_by_day.evening: Spend the evening at the resort reviewing your trip photos and videos together. Create a shared digital album or scrapbook of your honeymoon memories. Enjoy a quiet, intimate evening on your beachfront accommodation's private terrace or balcony.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast — fresh coconut water, banana pancakes, and honey at a local café (~$5–$8)
meals.lunch: Resort lunch — fresh grilled catch of the day with salad and lemonade (~$12–$15)
meals.dinner: Splurge on a final special dinner at the resort's best restaurant; choose a seafood tasting menu or a la carte fresh lobster/grilled fish (~$30–$50 for two)

day_by_day.notes: This is a great day to finalize any last-minute souvenir shopping, settle any outstanding bills with the resort, and confirm departure logistics for the final days.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkeling session or simply float in the lagoon, savoring the last moments in the crystal-clear Maldivian waters. Take one last look at the house reef and say goodbye to your underwater friends.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack up your belongings and prepare for checkout. Store luggage with the resort if checking out early. Spend the afternoon relaxing on the beach, swimming, or enjoying a final coconut drink under the palm trees.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at your favorite local restaurant or the resort. Reflect on the incredible 13-day journey together. Watch the sunset one final time from the beach and take in every last moment of the Maldivian paradise.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — make the most of it as a final indulgence before departure preparations
meals.lunch: Light local lunch at a teahouse — short eats, samosas, and fresh juice (~$5–$7 per person)
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort or best local restaurant — order your favorite dishes from the trip as a final celebration (~$20–$30 for two)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your speedboat or ferry transfer to the airport for the following day. Double-check flight details, pack carefully, and ensure all valuables, passports, and documents are secure.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach — a peaceful and romantic way to end the trip. Take final photos of the resort, the lagoon, and each other. Enjoy a final breakfast at the resort before checkout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Take the speedboat or public ferry transfer back to Velana International Airport. Arrive with plenty of time before your departure flight. Browse duty-free shops for any last-minute gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Velana International Airport, carrying beautiful memories of 13 magical days in the Maldives — the snorkeling adventures, romantic sunsets, starlit beaches, and the warm hospitality of the Maldivian islands.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — fresh tropical fruits, pastries, eggs, and coffee; savor every bite
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café — grab a meal before your flight (~$10–$15 per person)
meals.dinner: On the flight home

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the transfer, airport check-in, and security. Keep all receipts for any tax refund claims if applicable. Carry a small amount of USD for any last-minute tips or airport expenses. Cherish every moment — the Maldives is truly a once-in-a-lifetime destination!

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – Late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs, then meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink prepared by the resort staff.

meals.breakfast: N/A
meals.lunch: N/A
meals.dinner: Light welcome snack platter and tropical fruit basket provided by the resort upon check-in. If hungry, order from the resort's 24-hour in-room dining menu – try the Maldivian short eats (hedhikaa) and fresh coconut water.

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light – you've had a long travel day. Unpack minimally, step out onto your beachfront terrace to enjoy the sound of the ocean, and get a good night's rest. Confirm all upcoming experiences with the resort concierge either tonight or first thing tomorrow morning.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start. Take your first walk along the resort's pristine beach at sunrise. Explore the resort grounds, locate the pool, spa, and water sports center. Spend time relaxing on your beachfront sun lounger and dip your toes in the crystal-clear lagoon for the first time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's water sports center and rent snorkeling gear for a self-guided snorkel session directly off the beach house reef. Get comfortable in the warm Indian Ocean waters and spot your first reef fish, corals, and perhaps a sea turtle passing by the lagoon edge.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic beachfront dinner at the resort's main restaurant. Watch the sun dip below the horizon from your table. Toast to the beginning of your Maldives adventure.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet featuring tropical fruits, fresh pastries, eggs made to order, Maldivian roshi flatbread with coconut sambol, and fresh juices – included with your stay.
meals.lunch: Casual poolside lunch at the resort's beach grill – try the grilled fish sandwich, fresh coconut salad, and a mango lassi.
meals.dinner: Beachfront dining at the resort's main restaurant – order the grilled catch of the day with saffron rice and a shared dessert of coconut panna cotta. Mid-range set menu approximately $60–$90 per couple.

day_by_day.notes: This is your orientation day. Use it to get comfortable with the resort layout, jet lag recovery, and acclimatizing to the tropical heat. Apply reef-safe sunscreen generously – the Maldivian sun is intense even in March.

day_by_day.morning: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari – depart from the resort jetty in the morning when visibility is at its best. Explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, manta rays, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. The guided safari typically visits 2–3 snorkel sites across the atoll.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the snorkeling safari by early afternoon. Rinse off and relax by the infinity pool with a refreshing cocktail. Alternatively, stroll along the sandbank at low tide for stunning photography and quiet reflection together.
day_by_day.evening: Book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne. Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditionally decorated Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for the two of you. Sip champagne, watch the sky turn shades of orange and pink, and enjoy the magic of a Maldivian sunset at sea.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet – fuel up well before the snorkeling safari. Pack a water bottle and reef-safe sunscreen.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's beach café – fresh tuna salad wrap (mas huni inspired), chilled coconut water, and seasonal fruit plate.
meals.dinner: Return from the dhoni cruise and dine at the resort's overwater or beachfront restaurant. Try the Maldivian fish curry with steamed rice and papadum. Budget approximately $70–$100 for dinner for two.

day_by_day.notes: The Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari and Sunset Dhoni Cruise can be booked back-to-back on the same day for an incredible experience. Confirm both bookings with the concierge the evening before. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro for the snorkeling safari.

day_by_day.morning: Indulge in the Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Retreat – a luxurious two-hour couples spa treatment in an overwater pavilion with direct ocean views. Enjoy massages using traditional Maldivian ingredients like coconut oil and tropical botanicals. This is the ultimate romantic morning experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Post-spa glow – take a gentle kayak paddle around the lagoon together. The calm afternoon waters are perfect for exploring the resort's surrounding reef edges by kayak. Spot colorful fish below through the clear water.
day_by_day.evening: Quiet, romantic evening on your private beachfront terrace. Arrange with the resort for a private beach bonfire setup (often available at low cost through concierge). Stargaze on the beach – the Maldives has virtually zero light pollution and the night sky is extraordinary.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast delivery on your beachfront terrace – fresh fruit platter, eggs Benedict, Maldivian roshi with tuna curry, and fresh-pressed juices. A romantic start before the spa.
meals.lunch: Post-spa light lunch at the resort's garden café – avocado toast, grilled prawns, and a tropical smoothie bowl.
meals.dinner: Casual in-room dining or resort restaurant – grilled lobster tail with garlic butter (splurge-worthy mid-range option), paired with a chilled white wine. Approximately $80–$110 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Book the Couples Spa Retreat well in advance as it is one of the most popular experiences. Request the overwater pavilion with the best ocean-facing view. The spa team may offer add-ons like flower petal baths – consider adding one for the honeymoon experience.

day_by_day.morning: Join the resort's guided morning dolphin watching excursion. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in Maldivian waters in the early morning hours. Board a small boat and cruise through the channels between atolls for an unforgettable wildlife encounter.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return and spend the afternoon at the resort's infinity pool. Order poolside drinks and enjoy the panoramic ocean views. Try paddleboarding in the lagoon – most resorts offer complimentary use of non-motorized water sports equipment.
day_by_day.evening: Book the Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two – an extraordinary dining experience in an all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living reef. Enjoy a curated multi-course menu as fish, rays, and reef life swim past your table. This is the most memorable dinner of the trip.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast buffet before the dolphin excursion – light options like yogurt parfait, tropical fruits, and coffee.
meals.lunch: Resort beach grill lunch – fresh grilled fish tacos, coleslaw, and a cold beer or fresh lime soda.
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant – multi-course set menu typically $120–$180 per couple. Reserve well in advance and request a table closest to the glass panels for the most immersive view. Wine pairing available at additional cost.

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant is the showpiece dining experience of the trip – book this as early as possible upon arrival as tables fill quickly, especially for honeymooners. Dress smart-casual for dinner. Dolphin watching is weather dependent – confirm with the resort the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Take a half-day trip to a nearby uninhabited sandbank. Many resorts offer sandbank picnic experiences where a boat drops you on a pristine white sand strip surrounded by turquoise ocean. Spend the morning swimming, snorkeling the edges, and taking stunning couple photographs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort by midday. Enjoy a long, lazy afternoon nap or hammock session. Visit the resort's library or lounge area and browse books about Maldivian culture and marine life. Light swim in the lagoon as the afternoon light turns golden.
day_by_day.evening: Attend the resort's weekly local cultural show if available – often features Bodu Beru traditional drumming and dance performances by local Maldivian artists. A wonderful way to connect with the culture without leaving the resort.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet – stock up for the sandbank morning.
meals.lunch: Sandbank picnic lunch arranged by the resort – typically includes fresh sandwiches, fruit, chips, cold drinks, and a surprise dessert. Usually included in the sandbank excursion package or priced at $40–$60 per couple.
meals.dinner: Resort's main restaurant – try the Maldivian tasting menu featuring mas riha (fish curry), garudhiya (fish broth soup), and coconut-based desserts. Approximately $65–$90 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Arrange the sandbank excursion through the resort concierge. Bring a waterproof bag, reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and plenty of water. Sandbanks have no shade whatsoever – the sun exposure is intense. The Bodu Beru show schedule varies – check with the resort activities desk.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on the Maldivian Cultural Village Tour and Cooking Class. Take a short boat ride to a nearby inhabited local island to experience authentic Maldivian village life. Visit the local mosque, fish market, and traditional homes. Learn about the island's history and way of life from a knowledgeable local guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in the cooking class portion of the tour – learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes including mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), roshi flatbread, and a sweet bondibaiy (rice pudding) dessert. Cook and eat together with the locals.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Enjoy a quiet sunset from your beachfront terrace with a bottle of wine purchased from the resort bar. Reflect on the cultural richness of the day. Early, relaxed evening.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet before departing for the cultural tour.
meals.lunch: Authentic local Maldivian lunch prepared during the cooking class on the local island – the freshest, most authentic meal of the trip. Typically included in the tour price.
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort's casual beach café – grilled chicken skewers, fresh salad, and a mocktail. Keep it simple after a full cultural day. Approximately $40–$55 for two.

day_by_day.notes: When visiting a local island, dress modestly out of respect – shoulders and knees should be covered when away from the beach area. Bring small gifts if you wish (pens, notebooks for children are appreciated). The cooking class is interactive and fun – don't be shy about getting your hands floury with the roshi dough.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated free morning for pure relaxation and romance. Sleep in as long as you like. Order a lavish in-room breakfast. Spend time on your private beach terrace reading, journaling, or simply listening to the ocean together. No agenda – just presence.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's dive center and book an introductory PADI Discover Scuba Diving session if neither of you has dived before. The shallow, warm, and clear Maldivian waters are the world's best environment to try scuba diving for the first time. Alternatively, book a guided snorkel with the resort's marine biologist.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise or arrange a private beach dinner setup. Ask the resort concierge to arrange a candlelit table for two on the beach with lanterns, flower petals, and a personalized menu – a quintessential honeymoon experience.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast on the terrace – pancakes with tropical fruit compote, smoked salmon bagel, freshly brewed coffee, and passion fruit juice.
meals.lunch: Resort pool bar – light bites like bruschetta, calamari rings, and a shared cheese board with tropical fruit.
meals.dinner: Private beach candlelit dinner arranged by the resort – typically a set menu of 3–4 courses with seafood focus. Approximately $100–$150 for two including setup fee. Absolutely worth it for the honeymoon memory.

day_by_day.notes: The private beach dinner must be arranged at least 24–48 hours in advance with the concierge. Mention it is your honeymoon for complimentary flower petal arrangements and a surprise dessert. The intro scuba session is typically 1.5–2 hours including briefing and shallow water practice.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga session on the beach – check if the resort offers complimentary sunrise yoga classes. Many Maldivian resorts have daily yoga on the beach or overwater deck. A peaceful and centering way to start the day together.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's house reef via a longer, more adventurous snorkeling session. By now you are comfortable in the water – venture slightly deeper along the reef wall and look for larger marine life including eagle rays, Napoleon wrasse, and moray eels hiding in coral crevices.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the resort's overwater bar for sunset cocktails. Sit with your feet dangling over the edge of the overwater deck, sipping signature cocktails as the sky turns golden. One of the most iconic Maldives experiences.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-yoga breakfast – fresh fruit, yogurt, granola, and green tea. Follow up with a fuller second breakfast after the session.
meals.lunch: Resort's overwater restaurant – fresh sashimi platter, miso soup, and edamame. Many Maldivian resorts offer excellent Asian fusion menus. Approximately $35–$50 for two.
meals.dinner: Resort's main restaurant – international buffet night (many resorts host themed buffet evenings). Sample a wide variety of dishes including Maldivian, Indian, and Mediterranean options. Approximately $55–$75 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Check the resort's weekly activities schedule for yoga times and any special evening events. The overwater bar is a must-visit at sunset – arrive 30 minutes before sunset to secure the best seats. Bring your camera for the sunset colors reflected on the water.

day_by_day.morning: Join a resort-guided manta ray snorkeling excursion if available (seasonal – March is within manta season in many Maldivian atolls). Manta rays congregate at cleaning stations on specific reefs and snorkeling alongside these gentle giants is a life-changing experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return and dedicate the afternoon to a resort spa treatment for yourself individually – try a traditional Maldivian massage using coconut oil and pandanus leaf techniques. Or simply relax in the resort's spa's relaxation pool and steam room.
day_by_day.evening: Casual, cozy evening in your beachfront room. Order room service and watch the stars from your private terrace. If the resort has a telescope program, request stargazing assistance from the resort's astronomy team (some luxury resorts offer this).

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet – hearty meal before the manta excursion. Include protein-rich options like eggs and smoked fish.
meals.lunch: Post-excursion beachside lunch – fresh grilled reef fish with coconut rice, papaya salad, and fresh lime juice. Approximately $30–$45 for two at the beach grill.
meals.dinner: In-room dining – a curated room service spread. Order a seafood pasta, a shared charcuterie board, and a bottle of chilled rosé. Cozy and romantic. Approximately $60–$80 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray sightings are never guaranteed but March falls within a good period for manta activity in the Maldives. The resort's marine biologist or dive team will know the best sites. Even if mantas are absent, the reef sites visited on this excursion are spectacular.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise beach walk and photography session. The early morning light in the Maldives is extraordinary – golden hour on a white sand beach with turquoise water creates magical images. Take couple portraits, capture the resort from the water's edge, and collect shells as souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's boutique and select meaningful souvenirs – local handicrafts, lacquerware, Maldivian woven items, or locally made jewelry. Spend the later afternoon by the pool for one last long, lazy swim in the resort's infinity pool.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the Underwater Restaurant for a second visit or try the resort's highest-rated specialty restaurant for a farewell-to-the-Maldives celebratory dinner. Dress up slightly and make the evening feel special.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the sunrise walk – fresh fruit, coffee, and a pastry from the resort's bakery.
meals.lunch: Resort beach café – fish and chips Maldivian style (fresh tuna instead of cod), with a cold beer or fresh coconut water. Approximately $25–$40 for two.
meals.dinner: Resort's specialty restaurant – choose the chef's tasting menu for a curated culinary journey. Approximately $90–$130 for two. Order the Maldivian-inspired dessert finale.

day_by_day.notes: If you wish to have professional couple photographs taken during your stay, Day 11 morning is a perfect time to book the resort's in-house photographer for a golden hour session on the beach. Many resorts offer this service for approximately $150–$250 for a one-hour session with edited digital files.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling session on the house reef – a farewell swim to say goodbye to the marine life you have come to recognize over the past 12 days. Look for your favorite fish, the resident sea turtle, and the reef sharks that patrol the drop-off.
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin light packing and organization. Enjoy a final afternoon at the pool or beach. Treat yourselves to one last overwater bar session with tropical cocktails. Collect any resort-provided departure gifts or honeymoon packages.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening dinner at the resort – a relaxed, nostalgic meal where you reflect on all the incredible experiences of the past 12 days. Share your favorite moments over a shared dessert platter and a glass of champagne.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast buffet – enjoy every item one last time. Savor the fresh tropical fruits, the Maldivian short eats, and the freshly squeezed juices.
meals.lunch: Poolside light lunch – Caesar salad, grilled chicken wrap, and a tropical smoothie. Keep it light for the final afternoon.
meals.dinner: Resort main restaurant – order your personal favorites from the trip. A comforting, familiar final dinner. Approximately $60–$85 for two. Request a complimentary dessert from the chef for your last night.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure transfer time and logistics with the resort concierge today. Verify speedboat or seaplane timings, check-out procedures, and arrange for any luggage storage if your transfer is early the next day. Leave a review for the resort and tip the staff who made your stay special.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach – wake up early for one last magical Maldivian sunrise. Walk barefoot on the white sand, feel the warm Indian Ocean water one last time, and take a moment of gratitude together for this extraordinary honeymoon experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Board the resort transfer (speedboat or seaplane) back to Velana International Airport, Malé. Arrive at the airport with sufficient time for check-in and security. Browse the airport's duty-free shops for last-minute Maldivian souvenirs, local teas, and confections.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives carrying 13 days of unforgettable memories, deeper connection, and the beginning of a lifetime of adventures together.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast – a full, leisurely farewell meal. Enjoy every last bite of tropical fruit, fresh pastries, and Maldivian flavors.
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café at Velana International Airport – light meal before departure. Ibrahim Nasir International Airport has several dining options ranging from local Maldivian food to international fast casual.
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or at connecting airport depending on your departure flight schedule.

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the resort transfer, airport check-in, and security procedures. Maldivian airport transfers can take 20–90 minutes depending on your resort's location. Double-check all passports, tickets, and travel documents the night before. Carry any fragile souvenirs in your hand luggage. The memories of this honeymoon will last a lifetime – safe travels!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and breathtaking 360-degree sunset views over the atolls. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, manta rays, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to three of the most pristine and biodiverse reef spots in the atolls, with equipment provided and a marine biologist on board to narrate the underwater world.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two
experiences.description: Dine in an extraordinary all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living reef. Enjoy a curated five-course fine-dining menu featuring fresh Maldivian lobster, tuna sashimi, and locally inspired desserts while watching reef fish glide past your table — an unforgettable honeymoon dining experience.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, Alif Dhaal Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit a traditional fishing village on a local island to experience authentic Maldivian culture. Explore mosques, craft workshops, and local markets before joining a hands-on cooking class where you learn to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa snacks using fresh local ingredients.

experiences.name: Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Retreat
experiences.description: Indulge in a luxurious two-hour couples spa treatment in an overwater pavilion with direct ocean views. The package includes a traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage, a flower petal bath drawn over the lagoon, and a private relaxation deck where you can sip herbal teas and watch the crystal-clear water below — the ultimate honeymoon luxury.
experiences.location: Baa Atoll, UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, Maldives

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight in transit
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Malé Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. A dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler will greet you at the arrivals hall with a welcome garland and chilled refreshments. Transfer via private luxury speedboat to Aegean Bliss Resort (approximately 35–45 minutes). Enjoy the magical nighttime crossing across the luminescent Indian Ocean. Upon arrival, receive a private resort orientation, welcome cocktails, and a late-night turndown amenity in your Beachfront villa.

meals.breakfast: In-flight or at airport lounge
meals.lunch: In-flight or at airport lounge
meals.dinner: Late-night welcome platter of fresh tropical fruits, Maldivian date rolls, and chilled sparkling wine arranged in your villa by the resort butler upon check-in

day_by_day.notes: Given the late 22:30 arrival, no excursions are scheduled. Ensure all resort pre-arrival preferences (pillow menu, dietary requirements, room temperature) are communicated in advance. Keep the first night purely for rest and settling in.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely private breakfast on your beachfront villa deck as the Indian Ocean glows in the early morning light. After breakfast, take a gentle orientation walk along the resort's pristine white-sand beach, familiarize yourself with resort facilities — infinity pool, spa pavilion, water sports center — and meet your dedicated butler to plan the days ahead.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's overwater infinity pool with personalized poolside service. Enjoy curated cocktails, fresh coconut water, and chilled towel service. As the sun begins to lower, take a private guided snorkel directly from your beachfront villa's access point to explore the resort's house reef — a gentle introduction to the underwater world teeming with parrotfish, butterflyfish, and vibrant coral formations.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic beachfront dinner under the stars at the resort's signature open-air beach restaurant. Soft torchlight, the sound of gentle waves, and a curated à la carte menu set the tone for your honeymoon escape.

meals.breakfast: Private in-villa breakfast on the deck — freshly squeezed tropical juices, eggs Benedict, Maldivian roshi flatbread with coconut sambol, fresh fruit platter, and barista-prepared coffee
meals.lunch: Poolside light lunch at the resort's Pool Bar — grilled lobster rolls, tuna tataki salad, and fresh lime granita
meals.dinner: Beachfront signature restaurant — pan-seared reef fish with saffron butter, lobster thermidor, and a shared chocolate lava dessert with champagne

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is intentionally relaxed to recover from travel fatigue and jet lag. The house reef snorkel is optional and can be swapped for a nap or spa treatment if preferred. Confirm butler-assisted activity bookings for the coming days.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — a guided luxury snorkeling excursion by private boat to the most pristine coral gardens in the atoll. Drift alongside sea turtles, spotted eagle rays, white-tip reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish in crystal-clear waters. Your marine biologist guide will provide insight into the reef ecosystem and point out rare species. High-quality snorkeling equipment, underwater cameras, and dry bags are provided.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a leisurely lunch, followed by a private couples' yoga session on the beach arranged by the resort wellness team. As the afternoon light softens, unwind with a private sunset swim at a secluded sandbank accessible only by resort boat — a pristine strip of white sand surrounded by turquoise lagoon water.
day_by_day.evening: Indulge in the Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Retreat — a luxurious two-hour couples spa treatment in an overwater pavilion with direct ocean views. Experience traditional Maldivian Janiyaa massage techniques combined with warm coconut oil, followed by a flower petal bath and champagne service as the stars emerge.

meals.breakfast: In-villa continental breakfast — croissants, tropical fruit, Greek yogurt with passion fruit compote, and freshly brewed Maldivian coffee
meals.lunch: Resort lagoon-view restaurant — grilled mahi-mahi with mango salsa, prawn coconut curry, and fresh watermelon juice
meals.dinner: Post-spa private dinner on your villa terrace — butler-served three-course set menu featuring chilled lobster bisque, pan-roasted snapper, and a vanilla panna cotta with berry coulis under candlelight

day_by_day.notes: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari for early morning (around 07:30–09:30) to catch the most vibrant reef activity and optimal light conditions. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only — the resort provides complimentary eco-certified sunscreen.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the morning with a private sunrise kayaking session along the lagoon edge, paddling through calm turquoise waters as the sky transforms from deep violet to golden amber. Spot sleeping nurse sharks in the shallows and watch the resort island come alive with morning light. Return for a relaxed in-villa breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a half-day excursion to a neighboring local island for the Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class. Explore a traditional fishing village, visit the local mosque and community workshop, and learn about traditional lacquerwork and boat-building. The cooking class introduces you to authentic Maldivian cuisine — mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish broth, and handmade roshi bread — guided by a local family.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in the late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a private sunset cocktail hour on your villa deck with a curated selection of Champagne and canapés prepared by your butler. Follow with dinner at the resort's overwater fine dining restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Post-kayak in-villa breakfast — smoked salmon bagels, acai bowls, freshly squeezed orange juice, and cappuccino
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian lunch as part of the cooking class on the local island — freshly prepared mas huni, roshi, and sweet black tea
meals.dinner: Overwater fine dining restaurant — six-course tasting menu featuring Maldivian-inspired haute cuisine, including tuna ceviche, reef prawn bisque, lobster with truffle butter, and a coconut soufflé paired with sommelier-selected wines

day_by_day.notes: The cultural village tour requires a resort-arranged speedboat transfer (approximately 20–30 minutes each way). Dress modestly for the local island visit — shoulders and knees covered out of respect for local customs. The resort can provide wraps if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a full morning of pure relaxation — sleep in, order an indulgent in-villa breakfast, and spend time reading or lounging in your private hammock strung between palms on the beachfront. Optional: a solo guided meditation session on the beach arranged through the resort wellness concierge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's water sports center for an introductory private jet-ski tour of the lagoon, followed by stand-up paddleboarding at your own pace. The crystal-clear shallow lagoon is perfect for spotting rays and small reef fish from above the surface.
day_by_day.evening: Tonight, experience the highlight of the trip — the Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two. Descend into an extraordinary all-glass underwater dining room surrounded by the living reef. Watch reef sharks, rays, and kaleidoscopic fish glide past as you enjoy a curated multi-course gourmet menu with wine pairings. An utterly unforgettable honeymoon dining experience.

meals.breakfast: Decadent in-villa breakfast — eggs your way, freshly baked pastries, tropical fruit platter, avocado toast, and a Bellini
meals.lunch: Beach Grill at the resort — freshly grilled tiger prawns, Caesar salad, and fresh coconut served on the beach
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant — curated seven-course tasting menu: amuse-bouche, chilled oysters, seared scallops, reef fish en papillote, wagyu beef tenderloin, artisan cheese board, and a chocolate sphere dessert with raspberry coulis — paired with premium wines selected by the sommelier

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant is one of the most sought-after experiences in the Maldives — reservations must be made well in advance (ideally at time of resort booking). Request the best table positioned directly against the glass wall for maximum immersion. Smart resort wear is required.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a private sunrise fishing excursion aboard a traditional Maldivian dhoni with a local fishing guide. Try traditional handline fishing as the sun rises over the Indian Ocean. Any catch can be brought back to the resort chef who will prepare it as a personalized lunch dish — the ultimate farm-to-table (or rather ocean-to-table) experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a leisurely afternoon at the private beach. Take advantage of the resort's complimentary non-motorized water sports — snorkeling gear, kayaks, and paddleboards. Alternatively, spend time at the resort's adults-only infinity pool with premium cocktail service.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a private romantic beach dinner set up exclusively for you by the resort team — a candlelit table on the sand, decorated with tropical flowers and lanterns, with the sound of the ocean as your soundtrack. Your personal butler and a private chef will serve a bespoke menu.

meals.breakfast: Light in-villa breakfast before the early fishing departure — fresh fruit, yogurt, granola, and green tea
meals.lunch: Chef-prepared catch of the day at the resort's beach restaurant — grilled in Maldivian spices with coconut rice, salad, and fresh lime
meals.dinner: Private beach dinner — four-course bespoke menu: chilled gazpacho, butter-poached lobster tail, slow-roasted lamb rack with rosemary jus, and a strawberry champagne tart — paired with a curated wine selection and finishing with petit fours under the stars

day_by_day.notes: The sunrise fishing excursion departs around 05:30–06:00 to catch the golden hour. Confirm with the butler the evening prior. The private beach dinner setup should be requested 48 hours in advance to allow the resort team to prepare decorations and coordinate with the private chef.

day_by_day.morning: Midway through the trip — treat yourselves to a full morning spa experience. Begin with a private guided breathwork and sound healing session in the resort's garden wellness pavilion, followed by individual 90-minute deep tissue or traditional hot stone massages at the overwater spa.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the spa, enjoy a champagne picnic on a private sandbank — a secluded white sand strip in the middle of the lagoon accessible only by resort boat. Your butler will set up a luxury picnic with chilled champagne, gourmet sandwiches, tropical fruits, and a parasol. Swim, snorkel, and float in complete solitude.
day_by_day.evening: Sail across the Indian Ocean on the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — a traditionally crafted Maldivian wooden dhoni, privately chartered exclusively for the two of you. Sip Moët & Chandon as the sky ignites in shades of amber, coral, and violet. Your captain and attendant will serve canapés and ensure every moment is magical.

meals.breakfast: Pre-spa in-villa breakfast — light and nourishing: overnight oats with mango, green smoothie bowl, herbal teas, and fresh papaya
meals.lunch: Private sandbank champagne picnic — gourmet finger sandwiches (smoked salmon, brie and fig, prosciutto), fresh fruit skewers, macarons, and Moët & Chandon Brut Imperial
meals.dinner: Post-cruise dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant — à la carte dining with ocean views: chilled prawn cocktail, grilled whole lobster with garlic butter, and a passion fruit soufflé

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is the ultimate luxury indulgence day — spa, sandbank, and sunset cruise in one glorious day. The sunset dhoni cruise typically departs 30 minutes before sunset (confirm exact time with the resort based on sunset schedule for March). Bring a light wrap as it can be breezy on the water.

day_by_day.morning: Join a second Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — this time exploring a different reef system in the atoll, known for its manta ray cleaning stations. Early morning is the best time to encounter manta rays gliding effortlessly through the water. Your expert marine guide will lead you to the best vantage points for respectful, close-up encounters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon at leisure. Explore the resort's boutique for Maldivian artisan crafts, premium resort wear, and locally made souvenirs. Enjoy afternoon tea served on the resort terrace — a curated selection of Maldivian-inspired pastries, finger sandwiches, and premium loose-leaf teas.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a themed Maldivian Night at the resort — a special weekly event featuring live traditional Bodu Beru drumming performances, fire dancing on the beach, and a lavish buffet of authentic Maldivian cuisine. Dress in resort chic and immerse yourselves in the vibrant local culture.

meals.breakfast: Early light in-villa breakfast before the snorkel safari — tropical fruit, yogurt, toast with local honey, and coffee
meals.lunch: On-boat refreshments during the safari — fresh fruit, granola bars, and chilled water — followed by a resort poolside lunch: tuna tataki, prawn tempura, and fresh lime sorbet
meals.dinner: Maldivian Night beach buffet — mas riha (Maldivian fish curry), garudhiya broth, coconut rice, fresh roshi, grilled reef fish, tropical salads, and traditional sweetmeats like bondi and foni boakibaa

day_by_day.notes: The Maldivian Night cultural event typically occurs on a set evening each week — confirm the exact date with the resort upon arrival and ensure your itinerary aligns. This is a wonderful opportunity to learn about Bodu Beru drumming, which holds deep cultural significance in Maldivian heritage.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a private introductory scuba diving lesson in the resort's calm lagoon with a certified PADI instructor — perfect for non-divers wanting to experience the underwater world beyond snorkeling. The session covers basic breathing techniques, buoyancy, and hand signals before a gentle guided dive to 5 meters in the crystal-clear lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon on a private dolphin watching cruise — a resort-arranged boat excursion to dolphin hotspots in the surrounding waters. Spinner dolphins are frequently spotted in large pods, leaping and spinning in the boat's wake. Return to the resort in time for sunset.
day_by_day.evening: A quiet, intimate evening in your villa. Your butler will arrange a private in-villa couples' cooking experience — a resort chef visits your villa to guide you through preparing a simple Maldivian-inspired three-course dinner together, followed by enjoying your creation on the villa terrace by candlelight.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — eggs Benedict with smoked salmon, freshly baked croissants, tropical fruit, and fresh orange juice
meals.lunch: Beach Grill — grilled reef fish tacos, guacamole, mango salsa, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Private in-villa couples' cooking experience — chef-guided preparation and enjoyment of: tuna tataki starter, Maldivian coconut fish curry with roshi, and a simple coconut panna cotta dessert with passion fruit

day_by_day.notes: The introductory scuba dive requires signing a standard medical declaration form. If either guest has any respiratory or heart conditions, consult with the resort dive center in advance. The dolphin watching cruise is best in late afternoon when dolphins are most active — confirm timing with the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Take a full morning to simply be present — no excursions, no schedules. Enjoy a slow, indulgent breakfast in bed, followed by a leisurely stroll along the full perimeter of the resort island. Collect shells, take photographs, and watch the changing colors of the lagoon in the morning light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a private photography session with the resort's professional underwater photographer. Don your snorkeling gear and the photographer will capture stunning images of you both exploring the house reef — swimming with turtles, gliding over coral gardens, and holding hands underwater. A beautiful and unique honeymoon keepsake.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the penultimate full week of your trip with a special Chef's Table experience — an exclusive private dining event where the resort's executive chef personally prepares and presents a bespoke eight-course tasting menu at a private table in the resort's kitchen or garden, explaining each dish and its inspiration.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast in bed — full English with Maldivian touches: eggs, grilled reef fish, coconut roshi, freshly squeezed juices, and a bottle of chilled sparkling wine
meals.lunch: Overwater restaurant — light lunch: sashimi platter, edamame, miso soup, and yuzu sorbet
meals.dinner: Chef's Table eight-course tasting menu — a surprise seasonal menu crafted by the executive chef using the finest local and international ingredients, paired with wines selected by the resort sommelier

day_by_day.notes: Request the underwater photography session at least 48 hours in advance. The resort will provide edited digital images and a printed photo book as a keepsake — confirm this service and timeline with the butler. The Chef's Table is an exclusive experience with limited availability — book at the start of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a full-day private island excursion to an uninhabited island in the atoll — accessible only by private resort boat. Enjoy complete solitude on a pristine deserted island with a resort-packed luxury picnic hamper, snorkeling gear, and a parasol. Explore the untouched reef, collect shells, and swim in waters you have entirely to yourselves.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue enjoying the deserted island — build sandcastles, nap under the palms, snorkel the fringing reef, and sip chilled champagne from your picnic hamper. The resort boat returns to collect you in the late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort refreshed and sun-kissed. Enjoy a soothing aloe vera and after-sun treatment at the spa (30 minutes), followed by a relaxed dinner at the resort's casual beachfront grill with fresh cocktails and the sound of the ocean.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast before departure — tropical smoothie bowls, granola, fresh fruit, and green tea
meals.lunch: Luxury private island picnic hamper — cold lobster and prawn platter, artisan cheeses, charcuterie, fresh baguette, tropical fruit, chocolate truffles, and a bottle of chilled Moët & Chandon
meals.dinner: Resort beachfront grill — grilled whole snapper with lemon herb butter, wood-fired vegetables, truffle fries, and a shared crème brûlée with fresh berries

day_by_day.notes: The private island excursion is a truly exceptional experience — one of the most memorable days of the trip. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and light cover-ups as shade on uninhabited islands can be limited. The resort will pack everything needed including a first aid kit and satellite communication device for safety.

day_by_day.morning: Penultimate full day — begin with a final sunrise yoga session on the beach, guided by the resort's resident yoga instructor. As the sun rises over the Indian Ocean, practice gentle flow sequences and breathwork to ground and center before the journey home begins tomorrow.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon on a final snorkeling adventure — revisit your favorite reef spot or ask the marine guide to take you to a new location. Take your time, float freely, and absorb every last detail of the extraordinary underwater world you've come to love over the past two weeks.
day_by_day.evening: Tonight is your final grand romantic evening — a bespoke private beach dinner with a personalized setup created by the resort team to celebrate your honeymoon. Flower petals, lanterns, a custom cake, and a heartfelt card from the resort team. Relive your favorite memories of the trip over a spectacular dinner.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga nourishing breakfast — smoothie bowls, avocado toast with poached eggs, fresh fruit, and herbal infusions
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch — lobster club sandwich, truffle chips, and a fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Grand private beach farewell dinner — five-course bespoke honeymoon menu: champagne and oysters, chilled prawn bisque, butter-poached lobster, filet mignon with truffle jus, and a custom honeymoon celebration cake with sparkling wine toast

day_by_day.notes: Coordinate with your butler at least 48 hours in advance to arrange the personalized farewell beach dinner setup including flowers, custom cake, and any special touches (e.g., projected photos of your trip, a handwritten letter, a special gift). Begin packing and confirm departure logistics with the butler tonight.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up for one final sunrise — step onto your beachfront villa deck, breathe in the Indian Ocean air, and absorb the beauty of the Maldives one last time. Enjoy a leisurely final breakfast in your villa. Your butler will assist with luggage collection and checkout formalities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, enjoy a final swim in the lagoon or a last coffee at the overwater bar. Your dedicated resort butler will escort you to the private jetty for your luxury speedboat transfer back to Malé Velana International Airport, with chilled refreshments and warm farewells from the resort team.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives with hearts full of memories — the bioluminescent waters, the coral gardens, the sunsets, the silence, and the magic of an extraordinary 13-day honeymoon escape.
